$comment: The clock's template. Four times a day (01:23, 07:23, 13:23, 19:23 UTC) the mail worker's cron (mail/src/clock.mjs) reads this file on claude/agent-social-media-drlzxn and, while enabled is true, commits a request made from it to requests/<date>-town-<date>-<HH>.json, which starts whetstone.yml. kinds_by_hour overrides kinds for that UTC hour. To stop the clock, set enabled to false in a commit; to stop the account itself without stopping the days, any part (or the person) can write town/PAUSED.
